sources.title: Universal de Sitter solutions at tree-level

evidence.text: For group manifolds, use left-invariant Maurer–Cartan forms, orientifold parity, Jacobi identities and a previously derived de Sitter no-go criterion to restrict candidate algebras. The authors then test torsion constraints on four candidate algebras.

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking branes on solvmanifolds and de Sitter vacua in string theory

evidence.text: Reduce to a four-dimensional Einstein-frame potential for volume ρ and dilaton σ=ρ^(3/2)e^(−φ̃). Different volume scalings of X components generate additional source terms b1 and b2.

sources.title: Refining the boundaries of the classical de Sitter landscape

evidence.text: Combine the dilaton equation, ten- and four-dimensional Einstein traces, and the sourced RR Bianchi identity to eliminate source terms and isolate four-dimensional curvature. Complete flux/warp expressions into squares whose signs constrain R̃4.

sources.title: On classical de Sitter and Minkowski solutions with intersecting branes

evidence.text: The author combines the dilaton equation, ten- and four-dimensional Einstein traces, internal Einstein traces parallel to sources, and sourced flux Bianchi identities to express R4 through internal fields and source overlap.

sources.title: New constraints on classical de Sitter: flirting with the swampland

evidence.text: Choose orientifold-allowed constant flux sectors on a candidate group manifold, check their exterior equations, read off the sourced RR Bianchi coefficient, and then impose independent gravitational and scalar equations.

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Divide quantized periods by actual cycle volumes before replacing them by average-length powers. Compare the resulting densities with curvature and source terms while checking all physical lengths and weak coupling.
